title: observability: token & KV metrics + logging dashboards, alert tuning enhancements
author: Riley Chen
release_notes: Added token-level and KV cache metrics to observability dashboards; improved request lifecycle logging; tuned alerts to reduce noise and reduce paging. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: Production SRE and product teams have asked for finer-grained cost and latency visibility tied to token-level accounting and KV cache behavior. Existing dashboards aggregate at request-level and mask regressions caused by cache misses and outlier tokenization patterns. This PR adds token-level and KV cache metrics to the observability surface, wires them into new Grafana dashboards, improves request lifecycle logging for traceability, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce alert noise while preserving sensitivity to real regressions.

What this PR does: 1) Introduces token-level metrics (tokens_generated_total, tokens_input_total, tokens_per_request histogram) and KV cache metrics (kv_cache_hits_total, kv_cache_misses_total, kv_cache_hit_latency_ms). 2) Adds a compact Grafana dashboard (Token & KV Overview) with cost-per-token, p50/p90/p99 latency breakdowns by token bucket, and cache hit heatmaps. 3) Enhances request tracing to include token counts and cache decisions in the request span and structured logs (JSON fields: token_count, kv_hit). 4) Tunes alerting rules: migrate noisy /high-latency and /cost-per-token alerts to a new two-stage alert - warning (p90 over window) + critical (p99 sustained) with suppression during deploy windows. 5) Adds documentation and runbook updates for on-call.

Checklist: - [x] Metric names and labels reviewed with infra team - [x] Dashboard panels validated against synthetic workload - [x] Alerts tested in staging and tuned to avoid deploy noise - [x] Runbook and playbook updated - [x] Backward-compatible: no changes to public API endpoints

References: Linear ENG-8421, PM-302; related PRs: pr-26789 (previous dashboard iteration), pr-26210 (initial token metrics prototype).

review_comments: Maya Kapoor: Can we add a label on the token metrics for model and route to allow per-model cost breakdown? Author reply: Added 'model' and 'route' labels; we validated cardinality with SLI queries in staging and it's acceptable.

Diego Alvarez: The p99 alert fired during a deploy in staging. Suggest adding a suppression window or staging filter. Author reply: Implemented deploy suppression and added an opt-in label for noisier routes. Also added a staging-only silence in Alertmanager config.
Jun Park: Unit tests around histogram bucket boundary handling were failing on first run. Author reply: Fixed bucket boundary edge case and added integration test that simulates token bursts.
Maya Kapoor: Small nit on dashboard panel titles and axis units. Author reply: Renamed panels and standardized units to 'tokens' / 'ms'.
